name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Brush | Watermelon Burst
description: Quench your cravings with Fresh Canna’s 2G Live Resin Concentrate Brush – Watermelon Burst, a juicy hybrid that floods the senses with fresh melon flavor and chill, balanced effects. This easy-to-use brush applicator allows you to infuse your dabs, joints, blunts, or bowls with pure, terpene-rich live resin. With sweet watermelon, tropical citrus, and a touch of earthiness, this strain brings an uplifting, euphoric buzz that smoothly transitions into a relaxing, body-melting calm. Whether you're enjoying a summer session or just unwinding, Watermelon Burst delivers pure, fruity fire.
